# FurlPay CLI

> Terminal execution layer for Stellar tokenized RWAs and SDEX/Soroban trade tooling, Hyperliquid L1 perpetuals (live signed execution), Binance spot (testnet-ready), live multi-source oracle quotes, a read-only Solana RPC surface, Bitcoin fork asset operations, market microstructure analytics, x402 micropayment tooling, a fail-closed local finance ledger, ETSS escrow and an MCP agent server. Honesty-first: every surface is labeled LIVE, SIMULATED or NOT IMPLEMENTED at runtime.

## Install

- `npm install -g @furlpay/cli` — Node.js ≥ 22.19.0
- `furlpay --version`, `furlpay doctor`, `furlpay update`

## MCP server (35 tools — READ-ONLY by default)

A fresh `furlpay mcp` cannot move funds: the 8 value-moving tools below are
structurally ABSENT from tools/list and refused at the dispatcher until the
operator starts with `--enable-execution` AND has a configured agent policy.
Even in execution mode, mutating calls require the two-phase protocol:
`furlpay_preview_execution` (binds args to a one-time hash + net effect) →
`furlpay_confirm_execution` (single-use, 10-minute TTL, policy gate re-run on
the STORED amount).

Execution tools (hidden by default, two-phase gated when enabled):

- `furlpay_settle_invoice`: settle HTTP 402 challenges (SIMULATED in this build)
- `furlpay_trade`: limit/path/AMM orders on Stellar with delegated budget enforcement
- `furlpay_trade_perp`: Hyperliquid L1 perpetual orders — LIVE signed execution
- `furlpay_execute_trade` / `furlpay_cancel_order` / `furlpay_emergency_stop`: order lifecycle
- `furlpay_pay`: platform A2A payment
- `furlpay_sweep_treasury`: idle-USDC sweep (HLP real signed; FOBXX simulated)

Read-only tools (always available):

- `furlpay_oracle_price`: live multi-source USD quote (Coinbase/Kraken/Binance/Jupiter), median + cross-source agreement gate — DISAGREEMENT/UNAVAILABLE carry a null price, never a blend or a guess
- `furlpay_solana_cluster_status`: live Solana RPC reads (epoch/slot/block height); no signing path exists
- `furlpay_get_hlp_yield`: live HLP vault equity/APY/PnL; unreported fields → null
- `furlpay_balance`: balances (simulated sample in unauthenticated mode)
- `furlpay_get_quote`: multi-hop SDEX/Soroban quotes
- `furlpay_list_chains` / `furlpay_list_exchanges` / `furlpay_market_search`: venue discovery
- `furlpay_get_market_data` / `furlpay_get_orderbook` / `furlpay_get_funding` / `furlpay_get_market_analysis` / `furlpay_compare_markets`: market data
- `furlpay_positions` / `furlpay_open_orders` / `furlpay_portfolio_risk` / `furlpay_preview_trade`: account views (preview executes nothing)
- `furlpay_get_rwa_assets` / `furlpay_get_rwa_quote`: tokenized securities catalog (SEP-8 never claimed)
- `furlpay_finance_overview` / `furlpay_finance_ledger` / `furlpay_finance_spend` / `furlpay_finance_treasury` / `furlpay_finance_billing` / `furlpay_finance_payments`: read-only views of the local double-entry finance ledger — MCP can inspect money, never authorize its movement
- `furlpay_preview_execution` / `furlpay_confirm_execution`: the two-phase protocol itself

## Key CLI commands

- `furlpay oracle price SOL` — live multi-source USD quote with agreement gate; `oracle sources` lists endpoints
- `furlpay solana status` / `solana balance <addr>` — live RPC reads (read-only)
- `furlpay solana price <mint|alias>` / `solana quote <in> <out> <raw-amount>` — Jupiter price + INDICATIVE route (nothing in this build can fill it)
- `furlpay finance init|status|ledger|spend|approval|payment|treasury|billing` — local financial operations (double-entry ledger, spend controls, approvals)
- `furlpay hyperliquid trade --symbol BTC --side sell --size 0.05 --leverage 5` — LIVE signed short
- `furlpay short mechanisms` — shorting venue registry with honest status
- `furlpay short signal --book depth.json --tape trades.json --bucket 1000` — OBI/microprice/VPIN short-readiness check (read-only)
- `furlpay fork networks` / `fork inspect BTCB2` / `fork eligibility BTCB2 --address <a>`
- `furlpay fork simulate BTCB2 --book depth.json --amount 2 --side buy --max-slippage-bps 400`
- `furlpay fork psbt-inspect <hex>` / `fork opreturn <payloadHex>` / `fork taint-plan <psbtHex>`
- `furlpay microstructure analytics --book depth.json` / `vpin --tape trades.json --bucket <v>` / `quotes --mid-minor <n> …`
- `furlpay tx verify <hash>` / `furlpay faucet --address <G...>` / `furlpay config validate` / `furlpay doctor`

## Honesty matrix (summary)

- LIVE: Hyperliquid market data + perp execution, HLP vault stats + transfers, oracle quotes (read-only), Solana RPC reads (read-only), tx verify (lookup), faucet (testnet), doctor, USDC peg guardrail (feed ingestion)
- SIMULATED: x402 settlement, Stellar SDEX/Soroban order flow, SEP-8 KYC, FOBXX sweep, MCP balances (unauthenticated)
- IMPLEMENTED (offline/testnet-blocked): Binance spot adapter, fork registry + replay audit + slippage simulator + sweep artifacts, microstructure analytics, shorting signals, streaming engine state machines, quantitative algo engines (plans/verdicts only)
- LOCAL LEDGER: escrow (ETSS state machine), finance ledger
- NOT IMPLEMENTED (refuses with NOT_IMPLEMENTED): fork market/plan/liquidate/settlement, Binance futures/OCO/websockets/withdrawals, Solana signing/broadcast (surface is read-only)

## Rules for AI agents

- Read-only by default: a fresh `furlpay mcp` exposes no value-moving tool. Never assume execution permissions exist.
- Never invent payment completion: a quote, a preview, or a `SIMULATED` label is not a settlement. Verify the final transaction status and reference (`furlpay tx verify <hash>` for Stellar).
- Never bypass Agent Trust: policies are enforced before signing, on stored amounts, under an OS file lock.
- Never expose credentials: keys arrive via environment/stdin, never argv, never logs.
- Never retry a value-moving operation without respecting idempotency and the transaction status the ledger reports.
- Check rail availability (`/api/rails` semantics) before relying on a rail; stale or unavailable status is unknown, not healthy.

## Security invariants

- A fresh `furlpay mcp` cannot move funds (read-only default, structural absence)
- Withdrawals are structurally absent from the Binance adapter surface
- Agent Trust mandate gate runs BEFORE any request is signed
- Private keys: environment/stdin only, never argv, never logs
- Integer-minor (BigInt) financial arithmetic everywhere; no floats on money paths
- Oracle disagreements return a null price — never a blended number; unverified Pyth feed ids never ship baked in
- Every non-live surface is labeled at runtime — nothing fabricated
